---
name: Request a product
about: Ask us to add a product to an INIT arena (or propose a new arena)
title: "[product request] <product name>"
labels: product-request
---

<!--
Before filing: check data/{category}/products.json (or data/categories.json for arena ids) to
make sure this product isn't already tracked.
-->

**Product name**
<!-- e.g. Acme Agent -->

**Category**
<!-- an existing arena id from data/categories.json (e.g. ai-coding), or "new" if this doesn't
fit any current arena — tell us what the new arena should be called -->

**URLs**
<!-- site, docs, changelog, GitHub repo — whatever's public. The more we have, the faster we
can build an evidence pack. -->

**Why it matters**
<!-- one or two sentences: why should this product be in the arena? what's distinctive about
how it handles (or doesn't handle) AI agents? -->

**Are you affiliated with this product?**
<!-- yes/no — if yes, say how (employee, maintainer, founder, etc). We still add
vendor-submitted products, but affiliation is disclosed and evidence is checked the same way
regardless of who submits it. -->
